classification.summary: Compound-v2 fork empty-market donation attack on the soVELO market, executed in the window between market creation (timelocked proposal execution) and collateral-factor guard.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/sonne-finance.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.

sources.note: onchain review (RPC only, Optimism): soVELO market 0xE3B81318B1b6776F0877c3770AfDdFf97b9f5fE5 (storage slot 1 name 'Sonne VelodromeV2', slot 2 symbol 'soVELO', slot 17 underlying 0x9560e827af36c94d2ac33a39bce1fe78631088db VELO) created 2024-05-10T13:40:13Z at block 119874818. Compound-v2 fork, but a non-delegating CErc20, not a CErc20Delegator: over [119874818, incident block 120044611] the market emits only the two constructor events of CToken.initialize (NewComptroller -> 0x60cf091cd3f50420d50fd7f707414d0df4751c58 and NewMarketInterestRateModel -> 0x7320bd5fa56f8a7ea959a425f0c0b8cac56f741e, both in the creation tx 0x307b85a2fe776aad28ecc347e73170706850fea560479c78e7705c9332fb0feb); there is no NewImplementation (0xd604de94d45953f9138079ec1b82d533cb2160c906d1076d1f7ed54befbca97a) and no EIP-1967 Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b) log at all. Cross-checked with storage: slot 18, which holds the implementation pointer on a delegator, is zero for the whole window. eth_getCode is byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks (14896 bytes) and the disassembled runtime contains zero DELEGATECALL opcodes (the only 0xf2/0xf5 bytes sit at offsets 14812-14839, past the last executable instruction, inside an embedded event-topic constant and the CBOR metadata trailer), so the code provably never changed. CONFIRMED: deployment basis is exact, codeAgeSeconds 339587 (3.9d) unchanged; the exploit window was opened by market configuration, not by a code change.

exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (optimism block 120062493; victim in receipt logs): the first of two attack txs (DeFiHackLabs Attack Tx1); the second drain 0x9312ae377d7ebdf3c7c3a86f80514878deb5df51aad38b6191d55db53e42b7f0 followed 22 minutes later
